prov.text: Provision for credit losses : For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the provision for credit losses was $1.0 million, compared to a provision for credit losses of $0.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $0.6 million. The increase in the provision for credit losses for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was due to an increase in loan balances during the three months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to an increase in loan balances during the same period in 2025.

nonint.text: Non-interest Expense : Our non-interest expense increased $0.5 million, or 2.6%, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, from the nine months ended September 30, 2025 , to $20.9 million. The increase in non-interest expense was primarily due to an increase in compensation and benefits of $0.9 million, and an increase in other operating expense of $0.5 million, partially offset by a decrease in professional services expense of $1.1 million, and a decrease in data processing expense of $0.3 million, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in compensation and benefits is primarily due to the increase in staff levels, and annual wage growth. The increase in other operating expense is primarily due to an increase in travel expense, miscellaneous loan expenses, and miscellaneous operating expenses. The decrease in professional services expense is primarily due to a $0.6 million decrease in legal fees, and a $0.4 million decrease in other professional fees attributed to lower BSA related consulting expense. The decrease in data processing expense is primarily due to lower core banking system expense.

nonop.text: Non-interest Expense : Our non-interest expense decreased $0.4 million, or 5.4%, for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from the three months ended September 30, 2025 , to $6.8 million. The decrease was primarily driven by a decrease in professional services expense of $1.0 million, partially offset by an increase in compensation and benefits of $0.2 million, and an increase in OREO expense of $0.3 million. The decrease in professional services expense was primarily due to a $0.3 million transfer of OREO related legal fees to OREO expense, and a $0.6 million decrease in other professional fees attributed to changes in a previous contractual arrangement that resulted in a reduction to the overall contract cost.

pretax.text: Income Tax : Income tax expense was $4.1 million on income before taxes of $16.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, resulting in an effective tax rate of 25.1%, compared to income tax expense of $2.9 million on income before taxes of $13.5 million for the same period of 2025, resulting in an effective tax rate of 21.2%.

tax.text: Income Tax : Income tax expense was $4.1 million on income before taxes of $16.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, resulting in an effective tax rate of 25.1%, compared to income tax expense of $2.9 million on income before taxes of $13.5 million for the same period of 2025, resulting in an effective tax rate of 21.2%.

net.text: Net Income : Our net income available to common shareholders for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased $1.5 million, or 14.5%, to $12.2 million, compared to $10.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Earnings per share were $1.04 per basic common share and $1.02 per diluted common share for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $0.90 per basic common share and $0.89 per diluted common share for the same period last year. The increase was primarily due to an increase in net interest income and a decrease in non-interest expense, partially offset by an increase in the provision for credit losses.

ocf.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $32.1 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $25.1 million for the same period in the prior year. The increase in operating cash flow was primarily due to the increase in net income, partially offset by the increase in accrued interest receivable and other assets and the decrease in accrued interest payable and other accrued liabilities.

wc.text: We also originate commercial and industrial loans, which provide liquidity to businesses in the form of lines of credit and may be secured by accounts receivable, inventory, equipment or other assets. In addition, we have a consumer loan portfolio which provides loans to individual borrowers.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income is the interest earned on investment securities, loans and other interest-earning assets minus the interest paid on deposits, short-term borrowings and long-term debt. The net interest margin is the average yield of net interest income on average earning assets. Net interest income and the net interest margin in any one period can be significantly affected by a variety of factors including the mix and overall size of our earning assets portfolio and the cost of funding those assets.

The following tables present the average daily balances of assets, liabilities and equity and the respective interest earned or paid on interest-earning assets and interest-bearing liabilities, as well as average annualized rates, for the periods indicated.

intro.text: We are a bank holding company incorporated under the laws of the State of New Jersey in January 2005. Our business and operations primarily consist of our ownership of Parke Bank (the "Bank"). The Bank is a full-service commercial bank and is chartered by the New Jersey Department of Banking and insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (“FDIC”). The Bank conducts its business through offices in Gloucester, Atlantic and Camden Counties in New Jersey and the Philadelphia area in Pennsylvania. We, through our wholly owned subsidiary Parke Bank, provide personal and business financial services to individuals and small to mid-sized businesses. We offer a range of loan products, deposits services, and other financial products through our retail branches and other channels to our customers.
